import math
a = {f'w{i}': i % 3 + 1 for i in range(10)}
b = {f'w{i}': (i * 7) % 5 for i in range(5, 15)}
words = sorted(set(a) | set(b))
da = [a.get(w, 0) for w in words]
db = [b.get(w, 0) for w in words]
want = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(da, db)) / (math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in da)) * math.sqrt(sum(y * y for y in db)))
assert abs(sparse_cosine(a, b) - want) < 1e-9
